post.description:
Real-time streaming transcription via WebSocket.

## WebSocket Protocol

**Endpoint:** `ws(s)://<host>/v1/audio/transcriptions/stream`

This endpoint upgrades to a WebSocket connection. Do NOT use as a regular HTTP POST.

### Connection Flow

1. Client opens a WebSocket connection
2. Client sends a JSON **config message** (first message, text frame)
3. Client sends **audio chunks** as binary frames (float32 PCM, 16kHz, mono)
4. Server sends **transcription results** as JSON text frames
5. Client closes the connection when done

### 1. Config Message (client -> server, JSON)

```json
{
  "model": "whisperlive-base",
  "language": "en",
  "task": "transcribe",
  "use_vad": true
}
```

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| model | string | Yes | Model name (e.g. `whisperlive-base`, `whisperlive-tiny`) |
| language | string | No | ISO 639-1 code (e.g. `en`, `zh`). Auto-detected if omitted. |
| task | string | No | `transcribe` (default) or `translate` (to English) |
| use_vad | boolean | No | Enable Voice Activity Detection (default: true) |

### 2. Audio Data (client -> server, binary)

Send raw PCM audio as binary WebSocket frames:
- Format: **float32** (4 bytes per sample, little-endian)
- Sample rate: **16000 Hz**
- Channels: **1** (mono)
- Recommended chunk size: 4096 samples (~256ms) for microphone, 16000 samples (~1s) for file streaming

### 3. Transcription Response (server -> client, JSON)

```json
{
  "segments": [
    {
      "start": 0.0,
      "end": 2.5,
      "text": "Hello world",
      "completed": true
    }
  ],
  "language": "en",
  "language_prob": 0.95
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| segments | array | Transcription segments from the current audio chunk |
| segments[].start | float | Start time in seconds |
| segments[].end | float | End time in seconds |
| segments[].text | string | Transcribed text |
| segments[].completed | boolean | `true` = finalized, `false` = partial/in-progress |
| language | string | Detected language (ISO 639-1) |
| language_prob | float | Language detection confidence (0.0-1.0) |

**Note:** Each response contains segments from the latest audio chunk only (incremental). Clients must accumulate segments across messages to build the full transcript.

### 4. Error Response (server -> client, JSON)

```json
{
  "error": "description of the error"
}
```

### Example (JavaScript)

```javascript
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.example.com/v1/audio/transcriptions/stream');
ws.binaryType = 'arraybuffer';

ws.onopen = () => {
  ws.send(JSON.stringify({ model: 'whisperlive-base', language: 'en' }));
  // Then send audio chunks as Float32Array binary frames
};

const allSegments = [];
ws.onmessage = (event) => {
  const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
  if (data.segments) allSegments.push(...data.segments);
};
```

parameters.name: modelId
parameters.description:
Model ID enum (type-safe)
HTTP handler converts short string (e.g., "whisper-large-v3") to enum

 - MODEL_ID_WHISPER_LARGE_V3: Whisper models (STT)
Note: Whisper doesn't use vLLM, but we set vllm_version to 0.13.0 so the daemon
uses the venv that has PyTorch and Whisper packages installed (shares PyTorch)
 - MODEL_ID_GPT_OSS_20B: GPT models (LLM)
 - MODEL_ID_OCR_DEEPSEEK: OCR models
 - MODEL_ID_OCR_PADDLE_VL: PaddleOCR-VL-1.5: Vision-language OCR model (0.9B) running on vLLM
Supports: OCR, Table Recognition, Formula Recognition, Chart Recognition
See: https://huggingface.co/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR-VL-1.5
 - MODEL_ID_HIGGS_AUDIO_V2: TTS models (Audio Generation)
DEPRECATED: Higgs Audio has compatibility issues with transformers versions
 - MODEL_ID_XTTS_V2: XTTS-v2 (Coqui TTS) - Voice cloning with 6-second audio
License: Coqui Public Model License (non-commercial only)
See: https://huggingface.co/coqui/XTTS-v2
 - MODEL_ID_QWEN3_TTS: Qwen3-TTS - Multilingual TTS with voice cloning (3-second audio)
License: Apache 2.0 (commercial use OK)
See: https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-TTS
 - MODEL_ID_QWEN3_TTS_FAST: Qwen3-TTS-Fast - Same model weights as Qwen3-TTS but using faster-qwen3-tts backend
CUDA graph capture + static KV cache for 5-7x speedup over native PyTorch
License: Apache 2.0 (commercial use OK)
 - MODEL_ID_LLAMA_3_2_VISION_11B: Vision-Language models (VisionLLM)
Note: Llama 3.2 Vision uses cross-attention architecture which requires vLLM V0 engine (0.10.2)
See: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/27198
 - MODEL_ID_GLM_4_7_FLASH: GLM models (General Language Model with thinking mode and tool calling)
GLM-4.7-Flash: Lightweight agent model (30B-A3B MoE) with FP8 quantization
See: https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-4.7-Flash
 - MODEL_ID_WHISPERLIVE_TINY: WhisperLive models (Real-time streaming ASR via faster-whisper + WebSocket)
Uses Collabora WhisperLive for low-latency streaming transcription
See: https://github.com/collabora/WhisperLive
 - MODEL_ID_BREEZE_ASR_25: Breeze-ASR-25: Whisper-large-v2-based model fine-tuned for Mandarin Chinese, English,
and code-switching. Uses HuggingFace Transformers (WhisperForConditionalGeneration).
See: https://huggingface.co/MediaTek-Research/Breeze-ASR-25
 - MODEL_ID_LLAMA_3_2_1B_GGUF: Llama.cpp GGUF models (CGo bindings, no Python data plane)
 - MODEL_ID_WHISPER_LARGE_V3_GGML: Whisper.cpp GGML models (CGo bindings, no Python data plane)
 - MODEL_ID_QWEN_2_5_3B_GGUF: Additional Llama.cpp GGUF models (CGo bindings, no Python data plane)
 - MODEL_ID_QWEN_3_5_4B_GGUF: Qwen3.5 model family (dense + MoE, spanning edge to flagship)
 - MODEL_ID_FISH_SPEECH_S2: Fish Speech S2 — Dual-AR multilingual TTS (auto-detect language incl. Indonesian)
License: Apache 2.0
See: https://github.com/fishaudio/fish-speech
 - MODEL_ID_CHATTERBOX_MULTILINGUAL: Chatterbox Multilingual — Lightweight multilingual TTS with Indonesian/Malay support
License: MIT
See: https://github.com/resemble-ai/chatterbox

commonModelId.title:
ModelId - Supported model identifiers (source of truth for all models)
Used for metrics tracking, routing requests, and model path resolution
Path: ModelBaseDir + "/" + huggingface_id (e.g., /mnt/models/openai/whisper-large-v3)

commonModelStatus.description:
- MODEL_STATUS_COLD: Model not loaded (no daemon running)
 - MODEL_STATUS_STARTING: Model is loading (daemon starting)
 - MODEL_STATUS_HEALTHY: Model is ready (daemon healthy)
 - MODEL_STATUS_UNHEALTHY: Model loaded but broken
 - MODEL_STATUS_STOPPED: Model stopped/shutting down
commonModelStatus.title:
ModelStatus represents the status of a loaded model
This is the unified status used both internally and in API responses

commonOCRMode.description:
- OCR_MODE_MARKDOWN: Convert document to markdown with layout
 - OCR_MODE_GENERIC: Plain text extraction without structure
 - OCR_MODE_FIGURE: Parse figures, charts, and tables
 - OCR_MODE_GROUNDING: Extract text with bounding box coordinates
commonOCRMode.title: OCRMode defines the type of OCR task to perform

commonOCRResolution.description:
- OCR_RESOLUTION_AUTO: Auto-select based on available VRAM
 - OCR_RESOLUTION_TINY: 512x512, 64 vision tokens (16GB VRAM)
 - OCR_RESOLUTION_SMALL: 640x640, 100 vision tokens (16GB VRAM)
 - OCR_RESOLUTION_BASE: 1024x1024, 256 vision tokens (24GB VRAM)
 - OCR_RESOLUTION_LARGE: 1280x1280, 400 vision tokens (40GB+ VRAM)
commonOCRResolution.title:
OCRResolution defines the image processing resolution
Higher resolution = better quality but more VRAM

commonTTSLanguage.description:
- TTS_LANGUAGE_EN: English
 - TTS_LANGUAGE_ZH: Chinese (中文)
 - TTS_LANGUAGE_JA: Japanese (日本語)
 - TTS_LANGUAGE_KO: Korean (한국어)
 - TTS_LANGUAGE_DE: German (Deutsch)
 - TTS_LANGUAGE_FR: French (Français)
 - TTS_LANGUAGE_RU: Russian (Русский)
 - TTS_LANGUAGE_PT: Portuguese (Português)
 - TTS_LANGUAGE_ES: Spanish (Español)
 - TTS_LANGUAGE_IT: Italian (Italiano)
 - TTS_LANGUAGE_ID: Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia)
 - TTS_LANGUAGE_MS: Malay (Bahasa Melayu)
commonTTSLanguage.title:
TTS language selection
Language codes follow ISO 639-1; each model's daemon converts to model-specific codes

commonVisionAnalysisMode.description:
- VISION_ANALYSIS_MODE_UNSPECIFIED: Unspecified, defaults to GENERAL
 - VISION_ANALYSIS_MODE_GENERAL: General image understanding
 - VISION_ANALYSIS_MODE_DOCUMENT: Document/text extraction

commonVisionAnalysisMode.title:
VisionAnalysisMode represents the analysis preset for Vision LLM requests
